title: A parametric family of primes $p=km(m+1)+\varepsilon +2kq$: heuristic laws, conditional theorems, and unconditional primality certificates
summary: We study the parametric family $p_{k,m,\varepsilon,q}=km(m+1)+\varepsilon +2kq$ with $k,m\in\mathbb{N}^{\ast}$, $\varepsilon \in \{\pm1\}$, $q\in\mathbb{Z}$, which extends the elementary observation $p\equiv\pm1\pmod 6$ for every prime $p>3$. Each prime $p>k+1$ has a canonical triple $(m,\varepsilon,q)$ with $|q|$ minimal, mapping it to a generalised hexagonal base $H^{(k)}_m:=km(m+1)+1$ and a signed minimal offset $q_{\rm min}(k,m,\varepsilon)$.
